_readme: Regions drive shared course art (hero, scorecard engraving, collectible vignette). A course's region comes from its state. `scene` feeds the art prompts. Read by the app, the course seed builder and the art scripts.

regions.name: New England
regions.scene: rolling New England parkland: fairways framed by tall maples, oaks and birches, stone walls, a white clapboard clubhouse in the distance, gentle hills

regions.name: Mid-Atlantic
regions.scene: classic Mid-Atlantic parkland: broad tree-lined fairways, deep bunkers, mature oaks, a stone clubhouse on a rise

regions.name: Southeast
regions.scene: Southeastern golf: tall longleaf pines, pine-straw edges, sandy waste areas, warm humid light

regions.name: Florida
regions.scene: Florida golf: palm trees, bright water hazards, white sand bunkers, wading birds, big cumulus clouds

regions.name: South Central
regions.scene: South Central golf: live oaks, open rolling terrain, wide skies, a creek crossing the fairway

regions.name: Midwest
regions.scene: Midwestern golf: lush parkland, lakes, hardwood forests, a white farmhouse and barn beyond the trees

regions.name: Great Plains
regions.scene: Great Plains golf: windswept prairie grasses, sandhill dunes, endless open sky

regions.name: Mountain West
regions.scene: Mountain West golf: snow-capped peaks, dark pine forests, a clear alpine river, crisp light

regions.name: Southwest
regions.scene: Southwestern desert golf: saguaro cactus, red rock mesas, desert scrub framing an emerald fairway

regions.name: Pacific Northwest
regions.scene: Pacific Northwest golf: towering Douglas firs, misty mountains, links-like dunes along a rugged coast

regions.name: California
regions.scene: California golf: coastal cliffs above the Pacific, windswept cypress trees, golden hills

regions.name: Hawaii
regions.scene: Hawaiian golf: black lava rock, ocean surf, palms, a volcano on the horizon

regions.name: Alaska
regions.scene: Alaskan golf: glacier-topped mountains, spruce forest, a cold blue lake
